test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

The maid asked me if she could get me a glass of juice.

options.text: The maid said to me, “Can she get me a glass of juice?”
The maid said to me, “Could you get me a glass of juice?”
The maid said to me, “Can I get you a glass of juice?”
The maid said to me, “I can get you a glass of juice.”

solution:
The correct answer is **'The maid said to me, “Can I get you a glass of juice?”'**
